mapper.select: SELECT id, patient_code, full_name, date_of_birth, phone, status FROM public.patients WHERE id = #{id} FOR SHARE

SELECT id, patient_code, full_name, date_of_birth, phone, status FROM public.patients WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' AND (patient_code ILIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '\' OR full_name ILIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '\' OR phone LIKE #{pattern} ESCAPE '\' OR identification_number = #{keyword}) ORDER BY full_name, id LIMIT #{limit}
